**Now on macOS and Linux too.**

KnightSight leaves the Windows-only club. The same MCP server talks to all three, so an assistant set up once works wherever the share runs.

## ✨ Added

- **KnightSight for macOS 13 and newer.** One app for Apple silicon and Intel. It asks for Screen Recording and Accessibility the first time you share, and sends clicks and keys straight to the app that owns the window, so your pointer stays put.
- **KnightSight for Linux, on x64 and ARM.** A zip that runs with GTK 4 from your system, or a Flatpak that brings everything along. On X11 it frames the share and pictures covered windows like on Windows. On Wayland your desktop asks what to share, and the frame goes around KnightSight's own card.
- **Download buttons for macOS, Linux and Flatpak** in the README, each leading straight to the file.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The MCP server finds the panel on every system.** Off Windows it reaches KnightSight on its loopback port, and the "not running" note no longer names the Windows EXE.
